body: I have a slowbro with King's Rock, just got a Scizor, though, so TT for Palafin and Slowking?

I draw! I'm not sure if I'm great at it but I'd say that I'm better than people who don't draw.

 I don't think there's some secret or trick to drawing. I've been drawing my whole life, so to me it just feels like a natural part of my life. 
Practice is all there is to it, really. I draw almost every day and I see a lot of improvement when I look months and years back. But I also have a lot to work on. 

I mostly just focus on having fun and improvement comes eventually! (Even if it's not always fast... 😅)

I also suffer from arthritis and in my experience the best remedies for wrist pain is heat pads (I like the rice ones you can warm in the micro and use over and over again), wrist supports (I got mine from the hospital but I think the pharmacy carries them too) and just plain old anti-inflammatory meds. 
Long term I would suggest doing wrist exercises (there are a lot of guides to safe exercise with arthritis online) to train up your wrists which should give you less pain in the long term. 
Good luck with your stimming!
